answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 36211 Country: India Title: I want to take a mediclaim policy from any health insurance company. Is it right or wrong according to Islamic Shariah? Please give me reply. Question: I want to take a mediclaim policy from any health insurance company. Is it right or wrong according to Islamic Shariah? Please give me reply. Answer ID: 36211 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 204/204/M=1433) If medical policy bears interest or gambling then it is not allowed as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
